reason: 初次登记读取E108角色字段时误用中文显示名，真实原值是NATIVE_PRICE_RELEASE；断言失败发生在任何protocol/查询/GET/金融标签之前，仅修正原元数据字段名，初完整执行文本保留。
executed_source:
import json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
ROOT=Path.cwd()
D=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_full_joint_source_v1'
D.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def write(n,o):
    p=D/n
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('已有登记不可覆盖：'+str(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
old=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_competing_causes_joint_cases_v1'
proposal=read(old/'next_experiment.json')
assert proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
for item in proposal['parents']:
    p=ROOT/item['path']
    assert sha(p)==item['sha256'],item['path']
industrial_path=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1/全部79原期_完整原载体量义及保守公开钟与同钟多维状态.json'
industrial=read(industrial_path)['rows']
assert len(industrial)==79
assert [r['economic_period'] for r in industrial]==proposal['fixed_original_periods']
e108=read(old/'完整原正文副本及价格表规范化.json')['records']
reused={r['economic_period']:r for r in e108 if r['role']=='NATIVE_PRICE_RELEASE'}
assert set(reused)=={'2020M10','2021M07','2024M04'},list(reused)
records=[]
for original,meta in zip(industrial,proposal['fixed_original_period_metadata']):
    period=original['economic_period'];y,m=period.split('M')
    assert meta['economic_period']==period
    cutoff=meta['same_existing_decision_time']
    assert cutoff==original['comparison_existing_decision_time']
    source=reused.get(period)
    if source:
        raw=ROOT/source['source_path'];assert sha(raw)==source['source_sha256']
    records.append({
        'economic_period':period,'same_existing_decision_time':cutoff,
        'original_industrial_knowable_at':meta['original_industrial_knowable_at'],
        'source_status':'REUSE_E108_ORIGINAL' if source else 'NOT_LOCATED',
        'reused_original_source':source['source_path'] if source else None,
        'reused_original_source_sha256':source['source_sha256'] if source else None,
        'fixed_locator_query':None if source else 'site:stats.gov.cn '+y+'年'+str(int(m))+'月份 工业生产者 出厂价格 购进价格',
        'locator_query_budget':0 if source else 1,
        'first_raw_GET_budget':0 if source else 1})
assert len([r for r in records if r['locator_query_budget']])==76
parents=[old/'next_experiment.json',old/'result.json',old/'完整原正文副本及价格表规范化.json',old/'三原价格完整150数量行与原分组方法公开钟.json',industrial_path,
    ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_full_original_panel_source_v1/result.json',
    ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_full_original_panel_source_v1/原八背景九工业及基金整体原母体_未读股市标签.parquet',
    ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json',
    ROOT/'reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1/全部1711原成员_完整原载体保守公开支持.csv',
    ROOT/'reports/research/510300_industrial_joint_nonlinear_score_v1/result.json',
    ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fund_population_joint_nonlinear_increment_v1/result.json']
for p in parents:assert p.is_file(),str(p)
protocol={
 'study_id':'510300_ORIGINAL_PRODUCER_PRICE_FULL_JOINT_SOURCE_V1','experiment_id':'E109',
 'status':'REGISTERED_SOURCE_ONLY_BEFORE_76_LOCATORS_AND_RAW_PRICE_READS','registered_at':now,
 'hypothesis':proposal['hypothesis'],'research_question':proposal['question'],
 'unit_of_analysis':'原历史同一可知时点的价格调查、原工业量/成本盈利应收库存、原资金订单问卷和有年龄基金整体母体共同状态',
 'fixed_original_periods':proposal['fixed_original_periods'],'fixed_original_period_metadata':records,
 'original_industrial_periods':79,'original_member_count':1711,'original_score_date_and_pool_count':1212,
 'parents':[{'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':sha(p)} for p in parents],
 'source_authority':'原国家统计局全国工业生产者价格发布；仅公开历史原通报',
 'budget':{'fixed_new_locator_queries':76,'maximum_first_raw_GETs':76,'reused_E108_original_price_tables':3,'queries_per_unread_period':1,'raw_GETs_per_unread_period_max':1,
    'raw_GET_concurrency_max':4,'connect_timeout_seconds':12,'read_timeout_seconds':30,'TLS_verification':True,
    'raw_GET_retries':0,'alternate_carrier_GETs':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'new_financial_candidates':0,'new_model_fits':0,
    'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_labels_generated':0,'stock_labels_read':False,'new_full_accounts':0,'existing_source_code_edits':0},
 'locator_and_selection_rule':'每缺原期运行唯一已存查询；从该查询返回的结果按原顺序选择首个stats.gov.cn全国价格通报原页，结果语境显示同经济年/月和工业生产者价格，排除原因解读/地区/目录/其他年月。最终原全文自身标题、期、完整表方法与自己的公布钟独立核对；不合格或无候选UNKNOWN，不能转下一载体营救。搜索仅定位不是来源或原公开钟证明。',
 'original_HTML_body_rule':'只读取首次存下来的原HTML，TRS_Editor/TRS_UEDITOR真实正文；桌面移动重复正文逐字规范化比较，不算独立源。完整表/数量/原名称/分组/方法附注保存；同源解析边界错误可在未读标签前留原证据修正，不能改原表/源/月/时间。',
 'publication_rule':'页面自己显示的发布日期时间；只有日期则保守当日23:59:59，均不得晚于固定原截止。成文日/数据日/归档URL/取得日不作为历史公开钟。历史首版和独立验证未认证。',
 'table_and_scope_rule':'保存每完整原表所有原分组、所有原数量及环比/同比/累计平均，行数由原表决定，不预设每表50。保留基期/分类/样本/权数更换/舍入；不同价格篮子、工业利润企业与基金母体不互作分母，不跨基期拼接变化，不把原价差当利润率。',
 'projection_rule':'所有原1711成员与原1212评分日/原成熟池保持；按安全原面板已有工业经济期及其已有原决策钟接该原期价格。不用后一期，不换原期，不用前一期价格替代当前未知；价格自身钟必须不晚于逐个原决策。未覆盖保持UNKNOWN原身份，金融全门不通过。',
 'joint_description_rule':'只按原数量零界或原50问卷边界描述重叠多维条件：价格输入/产出压力、煤油分化、订单、资金价量、收入盈利、应收/回收期、库存、旧基金母体年龄同时保留；保留全部79期，不按股价选择状态。原解释、竞争解释和具体原因UNKNOWN分开。',
 'cause_policy':proposal['E108_price_cause_missing_policy'],
 'financial_admission':'全79/1711/1212量义时间门前不登记金融；全源通过也不自动通过收益。实质不同机制/用途需后续单独唯一非线性登记。禁止直接加PPI列营救E100工业19/E106基金27或旧PMI/订单/份额等冻结失败。',
 'frozen_failures_preserved':True,'original_scope_and_execution_mandate_preserved':True,
 'NO_VIEW':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False}
write('protocol.json',protocol)
write('原79期固定自身截止与76唯一定位请求.json',{'at':now,'rows':records,'executed_locator_queries':0,'raw_GETs':0})
write('运行前git记录.json',{'at':now,'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],text=True,encoding='utf-8').strip(),
 'HEAD':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,encoding='utf-8').strip(),
 'tracked_status':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short','--untracked-files=no'],text=True,encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'实验':'E109','状态':protocol['status'],'原期数':79,'原表复用':3,'唯一查询预算':76,'首次GET上限':76,'金融拟合预算':0,'源码编辑':0,'原登记SHA256':sha(D/'protocol.json')},ensure_ascii=False))
